name: list_releases
summary: a repository's releases, a page at a time.

name: create_release
summary: a new release of a repository, from a tag.

name: get_release_by_tag
summary: a release, by its tag's name.

name: list_release_assets
summary: the files attached to a release, a page at a time.

name: update_release
summary: a release changed, by its id.

name: delete_release
summary: a release deleted, by its id. Its tag stays.

name: generate_release_notes
summary: the name and body GitHub writes for a release of a tag. Nothing is saved.

name: get_release_asset
summary: a file attached to a release, by its id.

name: delete_release_asset
summary: a file attached to a release deleted, by its id.
